text: New Era is family-owned: Christopher H. Koch is the fourth-generation CEO of the family-owned company New Era (Jackie Robinson Foundation board biography).
short: New Era is family-owned; Chris Koch is fourth-generation CEO.

source.name: Jackie Robinson Foundation: Christopher Koch, Board Member
source.quote: Christopher H. Koch is the fourth generation CEO of the family-owned company New Era.
source.note: Page without a date; opened 2026-10-03. Forbes (15 Jan 2020) likewise reports New Era 'will continue to be family owned. Chris Koch, President and CEO of New Era, is the fourth generation owner' (forbes.com/sites/isisbriones/2020/01/15/new-era-cap-company-100-year-anniversary, opened 2026-10-03; the site blocks scripts).
